questions.question: The number of students in the class ___ increasing every year.
questions.explanation: 'The number of' = singular. HEAD subjek adalah 'number', bukan 'students'. Bandingkan: 'A number of students are...' (= banyak).

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the engineers ___ aware of the bug.
questions.trap: Orang cenderung pilih 'is' karena 'manager' disebut duluan.
questions.explanation: Pada neither...nor, verb cocok dengan subjek TERDEKAT. Yang terdekat 'engineers' (plural), jadi 'are'.

questions.question: There ___ several reasons for the server delay.
questions.explanation: Setelah there/here, verb cocok dengan noun yang MENGIKUTI. 'Reasons' plural, jadi 'are'.

questions.question: Mathematics ___ my favorite subject at school.
questions.explanation: Mathematics, news, linguistics: berakhiran -s tetapi singular. Jadi 'is'.

questions.question: The ___ of the new security policy took three months. (implement)
questions.explanation: Setelah 'the' dan sebelum 'of', posisi ini butuh NOUN (HEAD dari NP). Noun dari implement = implementation.

questions.question: She did not submit the report, ___ did she answer my email.
questions.trap: 'or' terasa natural, tetapi kalimat pertama negatif dan ada inversi.
questions.explanation: 'Nor' dipakai setelah klausa negatif dan diikuti urutan kata tanya (did she answer...).

questions.question: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?

options.A: He opened the laptop and, started the scan.
options.B: He opened the laptop, and he started the scan.
options.C: He opened the laptop and he started the scan.
options.D: He opened the laptop, and started the scan.

questions.trap: Opsi D: koma sebelum 'and' terlihat benar, padahal subjeknya sama.
questions.explanation: Koma sebelum FANBOYS hanya jika yang mengikuti klausa lengkap dengan subjek sendiri (B). C kurang koma. D koma tidak perlu: 'started the scan' bukan klausa lengkap.

questions.question: Identify the error: "The server crashed, the team restarted it immediately."
questions.trap: Ada tanda baca, jadi sering dikira benar atau dikira run-on.
questions.explanation: Dua independent clause digabung hanya dengan koma = comma splice. Perbaikan: pakai ', so', titik koma, atau pisah jadi dua kalimat.

questions.question: Which one is a fragment?

options.C: The scan failed, so we stopped.

questions.trap: Opsi A punya subjek dan verb, jadi tampak lengkap.
questions.explanation: 'Because the scan failed' = dependent clause (subordinator + subjek + finite verb) yang pikirannya belum selesai.

questions.question: What type of sentence is this? "She wrote the report and sent it to the client."
questions.explanation: Hanya satu subjek ('She') dengan dua verb (compound verb). Itu SATU independent clause, jadi simple. Compound butuh dua independent clause.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?

options.A: Although the exam was difficult, but she passed.
options.B: Although the exam was difficult, she passed.
options.C: Because she was tired, so she slept early.
options.D: Although the exam was difficult she, passed.

questions.trap: Pola 'meskipun... tetapi...' dan 'karena... maka...' dari bahasa Indonesia.
questions.explanation: Satu hubungan hanya butuh satu penghubung. Although sudah menandai kontras, jadi 'but' tidak boleh dipakai bersamanya.

questions.question: The teacher, (A) along with her students, (B) are (C) preparing for the (D) exam. Which part must be changed?
questions.trap: 'students' plural berada tepat di sebelah verb.
questions.explanation: 'Along with her students' hanyalah interrupter. Subjek sebenarnya 'The teacher' (singular), jadi 'are' menjadi 'is'.
